title: linux-admin 1.18.14 — RAID consolidated into storage
summary: Top-level skill count is now 73. The former raid-expert has been retired after mdadm degradation, rebuild, replacement, assembly-risk and recovery guidance was preserved and expanded in storage/chunks/raid.md. iSCSI, multipath, NFS, Samba and backup remain separate because their recovery semantics still justify distinct specialists. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
